2ba1fb68-eddc-4e1a-b407-4a6910abaa83.description: Oh, it seems that we have a poor connection here. First things first - let’s reload the transmitter's power source. A power control panel (on: Warehouse 2B) can reroute enough electricity. (before you ask - I don't know what happened. I'm just a system hint.)

16da020d-a1c9-4274-aa2a-291de1843dd1.name: Sensitive Data
16da020d-a1c9-4274-aa2a-291de1843dd1.description: One of my clients wants to get back lost USB stick with some private data (on: Warehouse 2B, Security Room). That's ok for you? I marked it for you

21ef6f76-f9ac-45c3-8c07-e906cf95fd2e.name: Lending a Hand
21ef6f76-f9ac-45c3-8c07-e906cf95fd2e.description: The old friend of mine is lacking... arguments. Help him and I'll pay you. Just leave them at the designated spot (on: Warehouse 2B)

74ec0b7d-1dc3-4c8a-9020-6a39656ef108.name: Corporate Voicemail
74ec0b7d-1dc3-4c8a-9020-6a39656ef108.description: Time to check a special place - Logistics Manager's Office. Details below

49515ed7-3b15-4446-8ada-f83b74ea2cdf.name: Life is a Shooting Range: Part 2
49515ed7-3b15-4446-8ada-f83b74ea2cdf.description: Rules are simple: aim at the head and pull the trigger

051e8397-3d48-4014-95b4-508bbadc5fe9.name: Recycler: Part 1
051e8397-3d48-4014-95b4-508bbadc5fe9.description: Recycling is the New Life. The Rebirth. The Renaissance

f1615800-7817-4eb3-aafd-23629fb7a36d.name: Recycler: Part 2
f1615800-7817-4eb3-aafd-23629fb7a36d.description: Recycling is the New Hope. The Truth. The Deliverance. Kindly drop off the stuff you crafted at the designated spot (on: Warehouse 2B)

9a726ebd-210b-4bed-bf55-b6bbb426d26f.name: Life is a Shooting Range: Part 3
9a726ebd-210b-4bed-bf55-b6bbb426d26f.description: It's easier to steal what you want, than it is to earn it

730a5408-6167-4807-87bb-647ea223aa9f.name: Army of Me
730a5408-6167-4807-87bb-647ea223aa9f.description: That guy with pistols... The craftmanship is... very good. I need some, and I'll pay good

c6f7ef3c-0543-4c9c-b095-153a86a1d605.name: Life is a Shooting Range: Part 1
c6f7ef3c-0543-4c9c-b095-153a86a1d605.description: Keep the distance. Check the wind. Exhale. Hold your breath. Push the trigger softly. Ok, part about breathing was a joke

20cf2223-5a50-49cf-857a-7f3435586ea8.name: Charging Stations
20cf2223-5a50-49cf-857a-7f3435586ea8.description: Not sure if those charging stations (on: Warehouse 2B) are working or not. Check them for me please?

b4feddb8-9f07-4b89-a90b-396221c6041e.name: Power Saving
b4feddb8-9f07-4b89-a90b-396221c6041e.description: It seems that someone has tapped into a fuze box nearby (on: Warehouse 2B). Find it and cut the cord

e2b27930-952e-458d-bb09-daa0cd66842c.name: Craftsmanship
e2b27930-952e-458d-bb09-daa0cd66842c.description: I see you have built: Armor and textile workbench.... Let's test it!

ee57e3ee-be99-4a96-bb39-ef89f432e264.name: Gun Tuning
ee57e3ee-be99-4a96-bb39-ef89f432e264.description: You have built: Weapon Workbench? Incredible! Now, let's tune something

42f83b8f-2d8d-424e-900e-1c3e99a6eaac.name: Peeking Into the Basement
42f83b8f-2d8d-424e-900e-1c3e99a6eaac.description: Strange activity is happening in that place - Logistics, Basement. It sounds like something is being dragged across the floor. Terrible noises. Take this key and figure it out

d65f5c75-13a5-41d5-9103-f2f480fef935.name: The Source of Metal
d65f5c75-13a5-41d5-9103-f2f480fef935.description: Go bring some good ol' metal

1e21e3ac-b2a2-4cb5-9514-1adfa5c73466.name: Headhunting
1e21e3ac-b2a2-4cb5-9514-1adfa5c73466.description: I'm planning to find at least three decent co-founders for my start-up. To raise KPIs and EBITDA. To skyrocket R1, R7, R30, MAU, DAU, WTFAU. I'm actually makin' these guys from scratch. Co-founder buddies. With some of AI stuff and VR and AR and all that fancy stuff. I will be adding some crypto. Blockchain... What else. Serious IT. Chips needed. Join us at Logistics, Warehouse 2B

3a4c0afd-0122-4587-86b5-48116d9a6f45.name: Pipes and Moustache
3a4c0afd-0122-4587-86b5-48116d9a6f45.description: You fix pipes I pay you we happy ok. You go Truck Stop on Warehousel 2B

4c91e394-d318-46b8-a447-979e36442d80.name: Customs Clearance
4c91e394-d318-46b8-a447-979e36442d80.description: One of my clients demands his cargo that is still stuck somewhere on Warehouse 2B Receiving Bay. Thanks to some kind of customs bureaucracy back in the days. The problem is that there is too many cargo containers and too many scavengers around. But I have an idea! Go there and scan the codes on containers. I'm paying very good for such an easy job

ff642824-d998-47ba-a2e3-4013f185e6c8.name: Wrench Fest
ff642824-d998-47ba-a2e3-4013f185e6c8.description: This world's goin' nuts so we all need wrenches to fix it

fe847765-d53f-4ba8-a51c-efbc3d4d8c51.name: Tangential Flow
fe847765-d53f-4ba8-a51c-efbc3d4d8c51.description: Okay, maybe it sounds strange but we need that ventilation system safe and sound. Grab some tools and do your best

e2e1296f-adbd-47e4-981a-2fd2977a68e1.name: Fly-by-Wire
e2e1296f-adbd-47e4-981a-2fd2977a68e1.description: Just like you and your rig. But who controls who? Anyway calm down and gather wires

87d649b7-80fb-4bce-a564-a4c0e673ee8a.description: This is the day I’ve been looking forward to for 2.5 years. Every once in a while, a revolutionary product comes along that changes everything and... ah, what was I talking about? Anyway I need a new phone. Paid job

8df62153-eb8c-4868-9acb-054e679d53c1.name: The Headless Rider
8df62153-eb8c-4868-9acb-054e679d53c1.description: I don't like your look. Nobody does. Take this and prove everyone wrong

196092e2-eb29-4c23-867f-be17ed86fc24.name: Cable Television
196092e2-eb29-4c23-867f-be17ed86fc24.description: Nobody needs cables these days...but me. Bring'em

674fc831-d64b-4296-9465-7ddb08a13d70.name: Some Inch Nails
674fc831-d64b-4296-9465-7ddb08a13d70.description: Not the nails on your clumsy fingers. Steel ones

07d3f39b-3f1e-448d-a082-bb8bca75e32d.name: That looks FOAMiliar
07d3f39b-3f1e-448d-a082-bb8bca75e32d.description: You know WHAT you could use the insulation foam for... Ah forget it. Give it to me and get out

15531059-972a-427f-a1a0-f5f864048a1a.name: Fabrics Fabricated
15531059-972a-427f-a1a0-f5f864048a1a.description: Fabrics are still being needed... you know.... So, please deliver some straight to my truck. I've parked at the Railway Station, Warehouse 2B

660e9d0e-bb9f-4b4a-8bc4-4082c3d179a6.name: Lending Another Hand
660e9d0e-bb9f-4b4a-8bc4-4082c3d179a6.description: Oh, it's so nice that there are still generous people like you in these cruel times. So why don't ya go out and bring me some guns?

510797f3-b24a-431a-8c41-506ed93f2436.name: The Cutters
510797f3-b24a-431a-8c41-506ed93f2436.description: I require some tools, if you find some - bring them to me. I guarantee fair payment

16ff4ead-2cc5-43c2-bb5c-04bcdf168e2a.name: A Picnic
16ff4ead-2cc5-43c2-bb5c-04bcdf168e2a.description: I need lunch boxes to store all the little things. Go and find some. I'll make it worthwhile

048db62e-ddff-4236-826a-65a1511d7e6b.name: Life is a Shooting Range: Part 4
048db62e-ddff-4236-826a-65a1511d7e6b.description: A several bullets to the head can be a very effective solution to many problems. Try it out (on: Warehouse 2B)

5544f7f1-ffc4-4197-ae52-53e074d84c00.name: Evil Corp
5544f7f1-ffc4-4197-ae52-53e074d84c00.description: Need a few umbrellas to fulfill my obligations under a contract with a certain corporation (can't disclose the details). Good payment guaranteed

9f03406b-85f8-48e8-8726-78dd66b2147d.name: Lost Property
9f03406b-85f8-48e8-8726-78dd66b2147d.description: A client lost a valuable music cassette somewhere on Truck Stop, Warehouse 2B. Wanna try your luck in searching for it?

1a4da2e6-7c63-4cc7-ac80-0278ac75e91f.name: A Party
1a4da2e6-7c63-4cc7-ac80-0278ac75e91f.description: A friend of mine is planning a "party", and willing to give a generous reward for a load of gunpowder in preparation for the party. Just leave it at the designated spot at Receiving Bay building, Warehouse 2B

6caefcfb-3a86-4692-a7c2-a34dcde068ce.name: Tree-factor Authentication
6caefcfb-3a86-4692-a7c2-a34dcde068ce.description: I've found a lead to some juicy, confidential information, but to get it you'll need to go through authorization from three different computers on Warehouse 2B area. First is in Security Room near the Quarantine Bay, the second is in personnel room in Logistics building, the third is in second floor office in Loading Docs with the stair entrance from the nearby parking. Then, you can return with the data

3ad8c770-c90d-47ab-8194-333d1ce9a0f2.name: Low Charge
3ad8c770-c90d-47ab-8194-333d1ce9a0f2.description: Need someone to charge this big loader somewhere in Receiving Bay area, Warehouse 2B. The client promises a fair reward

26d56ba8-bddc-4c39-99a6-f7eb1383e116.name: Healthy Sleep
26d56ba8-bddc-4c39-99a6-f7eb1383e116.description: New client requires several comfortable hammocks. Volunteer needed to carry out the search

e9192a7b-6c3b-41f0-ad1c-4b4e646fa695.name: Voltage Drop
e9192a7b-6c3b-41f0-ad1c-4b4e646fa695.description: One of the reserve generators is offline. It needs to be fixed ASAP. Receiving Bay area, Warehouse 2B

a5a38405-2999-4e91-a57a-be7073ca7042.name: What Will We Do With a Drunken Sealer?
a5a38405-2999-4e91-a57a-be7073ca7042.description: I need sealants to fix my lab equipment. Got some?

8b367446-df56-4c12-8449-9edd7399f04e.name: Packing for the Trip
8b367446-df56-4c12-8449-9edd7399f04e.description: A group of your colleagues is planning a long distance raid. Make sure they have everything they need and you'll get your cut

56e515f1-c81f-4719-b1ce-b02308339e4e.name: Zenith of the Textile Industry
56e515f1-c81f-4719-b1ce-b02308339e4e.description: These lightweight and spacious tactical vests are simply irreplaceable. I'd be *very* grateful if you could send me some

013ac99d-5e77-492f-ae70-6f80bbf43d9d.name: Aid Kits Cargo
013ac99d-5e77-492f-ae70-6f80bbf43d9d.description: My client's boat will soon be passing through. I need to prepare a shipment of aid kits for them. Just leave it at the designated spot in the outskirts odf the Scrapyard at Port

d95b6664-313f-4ca8-85e6-3f4506c3eb00.name: Hidden Blueprints
d95b6664-313f-4ca8-85e6-3f4506c3eb00.description: My contractor didn't manage to bring me valuable blueprints. Before communication was lost, they said they hid somewhere a flash drive with blueprints. It needs to be found. Possible location: east from the Fuel Reserve on Port

91145203-5bc4-4b13-a0d4-44c4eada065e.name: Humanity's Legacy
91145203-5bc4-4b13-a0d4-44c4eada065e.description: I need some shredded plastic, but I don't have the means to get it. I'll reward the effort if you send me some

106d39ef-f95d-458b-962c-129c8d4c4edb.name: Kitchen Tools
106d39ef-f95d-458b-962c-129c8d4c4edb.description: High-quality kitchen utensils can be sold for good money. I need one set: a pot and a kettle. Just drop them off at the designated spot in Logistics, Warehouse 2B

ca4348c4-1a73-461c-8f89-d3086c2046b6.name: Technical Inspection
ca4348c4-1a73-461c-8f89-d3086c2046b6.description: Forklifts in Warehouse 2B are very important to my operation. There are three broken machines that need to be fixed. Search them at Logistics, Truck Stop and Temporary Storage

82a3a9e4-774b-4c32-9e8b-2d345cec86f1.name: Big Bang practice
82a3a9e4-774b-4c32-9e8b-2d345cec86f1.description: Got a tip that our friends are planning a some kind of sabotage somewhere on Truck Stop, Warehouse 2B. Let's leave a little help for them

63f2cadc-8cdb-4041-8dae-7a4d40c5d535.name: Infiltration
63f2cadc-8cdb-4041-8dae-7a4d40c5d535.description: Heard about your exploits :) I need someone like you for a special job - retrieving a flash drive with a Fuel Storage customer database. Destination is Port. The trick is that it is locked in an office with an automatic security system... Key location supposed to be somewhere nearby

75bb8590-a7d8-458a-b74e-8a7a4cca96ea.name: Rogue AI
75bb8590-a7d8-458a-b74e-8a7a4cca96ea.description: One "genius" let an experimental AI into the communication network. Our IT team purged it from the network, but the AI have created a backup of itself on a rig roaming in Loading Area Administration, Port. Eliminate it and bring its ID chip

edfaa9f4-aa7e-484b-8026-37e1eb82bc9c.name: Unstable Connection
edfaa9f4-aa7e-484b-8026-37e1eb82bc9c.description: Power surges are preventing me from getting a stable connection to the communications network. Judging by the data, the related fuse boxes in Port are out of order - they need to be fixed. One is somewhere west from Logistics, the second one is around Scrapyard

47ff2757-a111-427b-a68e-18b9b45afbbc.name: Replacement
47ff2757-a111-427b-a68e-18b9b45afbbc.description: I hired a sharpshooter to keep the intruders away from the Electrical Substation in Port - he is doing VERY BADLY. Replace him while I look for someone else to work with

594541aa-e762-4b53-8040-d1efb2ef9ea6.name: Retrieving the Manifest
594541aa-e762-4b53-8040-d1efb2ef9ea6.description: Go to the Port. I need information about the cargo that was transported on the ship. The data is stored on a computer in Port Administration building, but to access it, you need to scan the QR code on the docked ship's superstructure

a358ebc9-16f1-4774-aaa8-66e1d2f60054.name: Attack Investigation
a358ebc9-16f1-4774-aaa8-66e1d2f60054.description: One of my facilities has been attacked. I scanned one of the attacker's memory module and discovered they were using some rig charger in Port Administration. You need to repair this charger and download the data from it -- so I can hopefully get a lead

6eb0d174-f71b-4b25-82cf-05b98d3fa7e0.name: Classified Information
6eb0d174-f71b-4b25-82cf-05b98d3fa7e0.description: One of my contractors hid a flash drive containing valuable research data in Port, Service Area. Find the key to the room where it is being stored, grab the flash drive and place it in the indicated place in Loading Area Administration

6dcd653b-e729-46b2-adf7-cbace1e451e2.name: Heavy Metal
6dcd653b-e729-46b2-adf7-cbace1e451e2.description: I need a set of good metal working tools. They are quite rare, but sooner or later you will come across them if you explore well. I'll pay well

8aa4361b-73ef-4cd5-b89c-422634517919.name: Construction Work
8aa4361b-73ef-4cd5-b89c-422634517919.description: Ok, now you are ready. First, get a good shotgun. Then look for a safety helmet. And then

4bcc6c69-804a-4efb-917a-5b2178f154b7.name: Breaching the Basement
4bcc6c69-804a-4efb-917a-5b2178f154b7.description: Smugglers that really like that certain Warehouse 2B basement are up to no good. Access it, place the transmitter on top of one of the cargo crates in the basement

de347a82-3073-4cd6-abe2-6ac56b45ce24.name: New Frontiers: Part 1
de347a82-3073-4cd6-abe2-6ac56b45ce24.description: When you are out there - you're in a Raid. You must learn your surroundings and adapt. Let's start with an easy one - Warehouse 2B?

8a2641f0-6ca8-4cd4-9ec8-16230cdf8caf.name: New Frontiers: Part 2
8a2641f0-6ca8-4cd4-9ec8-16230cdf8caf.description: Do you feel that musty breeze and residual oily smell? These are aromas of the location - Port. Let’s see what else is out there, but be careful!

57bc249f-495b-440e-bbf8-4f6053bbe45a.name: Trial by Fire: Part 1
57bc249f-495b-440e-bbf8-4f6053bbe45a.description: Good to know different ways of fighting the competition, let’s start with the basics?

de4c84a5-7c35-4d42-8be4-25cc719158ff.name: Trial by Fire: Part 2
de4c84a5-7c35-4d42-8be4-25cc719158ff.description: I think it’s time to show your skill with more “hands-on” weapons

b311f187-055a-45c0-8b31-cfc9a10059f0.name: Trial by Fire: Part 3
b311f187-055a-45c0-8b31-cfc9a10059f0.description: (sometimes) melee weapons can be as effective as firearms. Let’s take this one for a spin!

f9aa3a4a-0255-4da2-a68f-69a7b6f01876.name: Home Sweet Home: Body Crafter v.1
f9aa3a4a-0255-4da2-a68f-69a7b6f01876.description: Crafting is not just a fancy word. I once ignored it, got ambushed and ended up with a case of phantom limbs. Wouldn't recommend

e7ba823c-0277-435a-b927-b7945a6802bd.name: Headhunter: Part 1
e7ba823c-0277-435a-b927-b7945a6802bd.description: Today you’re starting Enemies 101 course. Today's lesson: Hoarder. To make it easier, here are the main distinguishing features: slender-built, chaotic, act solo or in group Can you identify and eliminate some?

ac485576-480d-4b7f-8f61-c6a0af1e67cc.name: Headhunter: Part 2
ac485576-480d-4b7f-8f61-c6a0af1e67cc.description: Next two are tricky, but important to distinguish. They carry out the law. Here's the BOLO: - Shared Features - bigger, armored up, melee weapons only; - Enforcer - wears blue uniform; - Rookie - well, you can't miss that

d731abf5-65e8-4e5c-ba3d-06b0e672edfb.name: ABCs: Response Test
d731abf5-65e8-4e5c-ba3d-06b0e672edfb.description: "Machine" learning is going smoothly. Let me check how good are your "response timing". Get me a special issue of SoyTech News (on: Warehouse 2B), just pick it up. Simple routine like this should be of great value to calibrate your Rig

45ae19b9-5eb6-4005-88ad-a00547e7eeec.name: ABCs: The Warm Up
45ae19b9-5eb6-4005-88ad-a00547e7eeec.description: Success. The signal is strong enough. Oh, it seems you need to "break in" your Rig, you still move a little... awkward. Loosen up with cutting something peculiar (on: Warehouse 2B)!

707f06d5-9528-4583-ae72-a8721e4336f2.name: Home Sweet Home: Armor and textile workbench v.1
707f06d5-9528-4583-ae72-a8721e4336f2.description: Remember to keep yourself equipped at all times. Building: Armor and textile workbench - can help with that

70a74039-3b0e-41a4-a820-d4b29ffcb8bf.name: Home Sweet Home: Recycler v.1
70a74039-3b0e-41a4-a820-d4b29ffcb8bf.description: The “Trash Cycle” is an essential part of your operation. And what is the perfect machine to help with that? That’s right - Recycler

31bfdc57-3cd5-438d-adae-690333df6b42.name: Shopaholic: Part 1
31bfdc57-3cd5-438d-adae-690333df6b42.description: Take it from a shopping expert - exhaust every opportunity whenever you can. If you forgot to buy anything beforehand, you can always use your own - Raid Shop. You've probably already discovered it, but why not buy anything from it again?

5712aae3-0130-4bbd-8c68-aaefd55773e5.name: Trial by Fire: Part 4
5712aae3-0130-4bbd-8c68-aaefd55773e5.description: High stopping power, yet close range - sounds like a shotgun? Because it is! I promise, if you take it for a spin, you won’t regret it

dc9b755f-2c79-4048-8101-7ea56262c716.name: Trial by Fire: Part 5
dc9b755f-2c79-4048-8101-7ea56262c716.description: I am feeling very as-salty today, get it? M. Trigger claims, that there are no “favorites” in choosing weapons. That it is all based on “skill”. Well, he demands on headshots

924db973-f452-4b03-a639-43cb9038bd34.name: Shopaholic: Part 1
924db973-f452-4b03-a639-43cb9038bd34.description: There are many ways to sustain the economy in this world, and one of them is simple trading. Simply go to - Shopping - and have fun. \u2022 Have fun ""

0a5f8010-8dfb-4c99-9648-406958aeb6ae.name: Shopaholic: Part 2
0a5f8010-8dfb-4c99-9648-406958aeb6ae.description: Liked that influx of sweet-sweet cash? I thought so. How about you earn more? For a rainy day. And purge your storage along the way

ad88be65-a343-431f-9388-e67859537523.alias: MISSIONS/BASIC/B003 - COUNCIL OF THETA/M0001_THE GRAND REBOOT/mission_basic_b003_0001_0000
ad88be65-a343-431f-9388-e67859537523.name: The Grand Reboot
ad88be65-a343-431f-9388-e67859537523.description: You have successfully integrated into workflow! Just one more thing… Transmitter is ok, but the download speed is low. You need to reset the transmitter manually. A familiar lever (on: Warehouse 2B) can help with that…

dc4c8ebd-e5f9-4736-b310-8a9959926f11.name: ABCs: Unboxing
dc4c8ebd-e5f9-4736-b310-8a9959926f11.description: Have you already listened to your looting instincts? Ah, all this shiny useless junk… Anyway, I need you to inspect certain... toolboxes that I marked specifically for you. They are located on: Warehouse 2B. (These routine actions help me isolate your unique signature to offer you better calibration options in the future)

4851914f-1fb8-4c46-a9cd-339c61897c63.name: ABCs: Quid pro Quo
4851914f-1fb8-4c46-a9cd-339c61897c63.description: An associate of mine, a very important person, would like to start some business here, so do me favor. Associate's Web connection has been blocked by some rogue transmission. I need you to locate the transmission source here: (on: Warehouse 2B) and stop the transmission by turning off the source. You would really do a solid. In the meantime, I’m going to track the one behind it

90c00d22-22ea-49b6-b4ba-3605ce8d7398.name: ABCs: Target Practice
90c00d22-22ea-49b6-b4ba-3605ce8d7398.description: I got an approximate location of the one who crossed my associate. The culprit is in a certain building (on: Warehouse 2B). I can't detect which one inside is the culprit, so KILL'EM ALL excuse me - eliminate several just to make sure. I marked the building. What's in it for you? Who knows... But at least you can practice some shooting. You need it

15cab819-3995-464e-8802-292d5249451e.name: ABCs: Head Check
15cab819-3995-464e-8802-292d5249451e.description: Now, back to routine calibrations… I noticed something is wrong with your head module. It’s better to fix it ASAP. Swap your current head with the top-notch one, which my connections provided for you (on: Warehouse 2B)

1d4bcf10-cb88-4280-b749-b70eb0409bcf.name: ABCs: Hidden Gems
1d4bcf10-cb88-4280-b749-b70eb0409bcf.description: Nice work on that previous task. The group that’s been watching you is interested to see your holistic response to unscripted situations... Anything can happen in the raid, especially, when you interact with hidden in plain sight gems…like forklift (on: Warehouse 2B)

955ea658-5286-495f-9c46-d82757677eab.name: Mousetrap: Part 1
955ea658-5286-495f-9c46-d82757677eab.description: I’ve been monitoring some scavenger radio chatter and words “Progenitor” and “Helicopter” come up A LOT. Something to do with that crashed helicopter and secret data it was transporting. It could be worth looking into... ...but it might get tricky to get into the building, or out of it…

f51bf657-baa1-4956-9e76-c94fb0fa295a.name: Mousetrap: Part 2
f51bf657-baa1-4956-9e76-c94fb0fa295a.description: The documents were incomplete. I mean, there was supposed to be something else in that helicopter - a very VERY precious thumb drive, with information that could change the world. Good news? It is still somewhere in the building. The storage device is camouflaged though, but I know just the device to fry it. I will set it up, but I’m missing some keys from the area that would allow me to move freely. Your help in this matter is highly appreciated

f68451f5-6981-4b62-937c-e37110212d78.name: Mousetrap: Part 3
f68451f5-6981-4b62-937c-e37110212d78.description: I successfully planted my EMP-Anticamouflage-SuperSpy-Devices on all floors. However… There’s some interference, probably from all the happening activity. Eliminate some around the building to let my beauties do the work in peace

9f15b99c-b2a4-4bc0-a2b9-0e4408544b03.name: Mousetrap: Part 4
9f15b99c-b2a4-4bc0-a2b9-0e4408544b03.description: Got it! It was on the 4F all along. But someone hid it in a very sneaky place, not so easy to spot. Deliver it to me and I will make sure it will be safely stashed away, until the right time comes

cfcd6054-f236-48fd-bd87-bb1b6b78a74b.name: ABCs: Better Safe Than Sorry
cfcd6054-f236-48fd-bd87-bb1b6b78a74b.description: Previous owner was way much of a frugalist. Which I'm sure you're not. Existing without stuff is not an option, thus - better not lose it in the first place. For that - build: Lost and found - in your shelter. It will come in handy greatly

eebc2fc3-03fd-402c-8598-2c913202f309.name: Talking Head: Part 1
eebc2fc3-03fd-402c-8598-2c913202f309.description: Someone named "Bobby" reached out to me with an urgent and a distressing request. Normally, I would ignore it, considering amount of weird out there. But I can't shake off this feeling that I know Bobby from somewhere... Anyway, Bobby would only share details in person. Would you, please, take this matter in your hands and see what's going on? Port is the place

a1b0fe67-3434-469c-81db-360d977a20b5.name: Talking Head: Part 2
a1b0fe67-3434-469c-81db-360d977a20b5.description: My friends weren't as lucky as I was... All they have left are... heads. "The Doctor" - the person behind these gruesome acts. Double-crossing, wronging or even bringing pizza cold - all of that could make you into what I am now... The "work" was conducted around various workshops and parking garages. If I were you - I'd start from there. BUT! My friends' memory modules are very fragile and have to be collected all at once. Otherwise, their essences would be unrecoverable

d9580035-b861-42e7-852b-b754a2a6aa30.name: Talking Head: Part 3
d9580035-b861-42e7-852b-b754a2a6aa30.description: I deeply appreciate your help with rescuing my friends. They are also very grateful.. and ready for revenge. Some preparations are needed to be done first. Would you land us a hand with that? You would require special equipment. I can provide you with it by simply "patching" a familiar tool.. Trust me, this equipment will be very valuable to you in the future as well

7760333a-2e83-4dab-92b4-3e7cebc504c9.name: Talking Head: Part 4
7760333a-2e83-4dab-92b4-3e7cebc504c9.description: Now, take the tool I crafted for you, identify the Doctor's workshop, and bug it... somewhere around it... We need to get the schedule, the routine, every move.... ...so we can commence a revengeful strike... Act quickly - or you'll have to redo everything. If you loose the tool - I gave my associate permission to sell it to you. Unfortunately, I can only share workshop's last known location: Warehouse 2B

b9338918-63df-491a-917d-0a2fd0527638.name: Dirty Business: Part 1
b9338918-63df-491a-917d-0a2fd0527638.description: I'm thinking it's nice you bumped into me... I could let you in on what’s happening... you might be helpful after all, I guess? Firstly, check on THE OTHERS. After what we've been through they might be lacking resources for whatever dirty plan they're scheming. Locate whoever's left in Port, and bring them what they are asking for. Ask why later. The tricky part? There is no information where they are, who they are or if they're even capable of giving clear instructions to tell you what they need. Good luck in your search…

63a74a6a-2251-44ad-bfa8-e277ecab20ba.name: Dirty Business: Part 2
63a74a6a-2251-44ad-bfa8-e277ecab20ba.description: I hope the items they requested and the methods they've chosen would get them... far, because THIS.IS.TURF.WAR!! We have to win by any means necessary! What they have done... Inconceivable... And in such manner... Oh my, oh my... I can't even describe... This cannot be put to words! Just join us in the fight! Without reason, for now

1b8ee798-45f1-4e06-9b91-91a3c6c51f34.name: Dirty Business: Part 3
1b8ee798-45f1-4e06-9b91-91a3c6c51f34.description: That was some excellent work! A cause for celebration! One last hurrah, no strings attached, whatever happens at the party - stays at the party ;) How about a masquerade? Details in person! I have also prepared something to buy your silence, a very special reward... But party first!

2bf5f986-2228-41de-8b94-3778b7e3cfe8.name: Shadows of Port: Part 1
2bf5f986-2228-41de-8b94-3778b7e3cfe8.description: Tis was a cold tired morning at the docks... My partner set out on a perilous quest to bring certain individuals to justice. The path was hard: shadows behind every corner, cold trails, sleepless nights. But then - a break in the case. I get a message "I have the evidence to bring them down!". Unfortunately, it was followed by a dead silence. I fear the worst, but I have to be sure what my partner got involved into. Do you accept this investigation?

44b84a1d-a39d-4418-8281-563541d0b732.name: Shadows of Port: Part 2
44b84a1d-a39d-4418-8281-563541d0b732.description: Tis clear as day now, behind this cruel murder are they - Port Mafia. It wasn't out of the blue, my partner got solid official evidence that the mafia is deep into illegal activity. There were rumors, but NO ONE could find proof before. Until now. However, who was the one that pulled the trigger? I swiped the murder site, but found nothing - they clean up good, but let's hope they are not smart enough to get rid of ALL the evidence. The documents you brought me contain important receipts and books. We need to follow the money, right to the one who make this money happen - Port Mafia Accountant. From there - we might be able to get more leads

8e774b7a-81df-4cc5-8790-a03c266b9e17.name: Shadows of Port: Part 3
8e774b7a-81df-4cc5-8790-a03c266b9e17.description: AMATEURS! When you hacked the computer I learned that some rookie took the gun instead of getting rid of it. More good news - this rookie is attending the secret meeting for which you found the coordinates! It's time to crash this party! But very very SILENTLY. We don't want other mafia members to know what's happening

1774c157-8cfd-4906-bfa2-6917da1ae477.name: Shadows of Port: Part 4
1774c157-8cfd-4906-bfa2-6917da1ae477.description: Typical. I contacted some authorized sources and they refused to help bring mafia's activity to light. My guess why? Check their bank accounts. The justice is solely in our hands now. The evidence you extracted, I analyzed it - it is Boss'es signature handgun. That is perfect! We eliminate the head, and the tail will follow! Two birds with one stone! Vengeance and justice! To the docks!

d23578e3-5a51-4726-9b55-36ebd7847fa6.name: Diary of a toymaker. Page 1
d23578e3-5a51-4726-9b55-36ebd7847fa6.description: What made us human? Hobbies. The joy of working with your hands. The smell of fresh wood shavings. Time flying by unnoticed while you craft something. The delight of those you give your handmade creations to. Can these ugly metal hands ever create something beautiful again?! See for yourself - you can look around the garage workshop near the perimeter fence. -Lars

9f241f3c-efe6-42e1-a8a9-cab0399c8276.name: Diary of a toymaker. Page 2
9f241f3c-efe6-42e1-a8a9-cab0399c8276.description: We don’t value what we have. When it’s gone, we mourn it. Trains. Where are they now? Do you remember how, as kids, we would press our ears to the rails warmed by the spring sun and hear that growing rhythm - the beating of a great heart? And when grandpa told us about steam locomotives, we feel a quiet sadness that we had never seen the clouds of steam wrapping the whole station, never flinched with joy at the sudden whistle. -Lars

8883389a-47bd-4dff-98b9-93e3ea602961.name: Diary of a toymaker. Page 3
8883389a-47bd-4dff-98b9-93e3ea602961.description: We can no longer taste food. Try to remember - what does freshly baked bread taste like? Impossible. First, we got rid of bakers and bakeries for the sake of comfort and the cornucopia promised by supermarkets. Then we reinvented bakeries, only to buy overpriced bread with all kinds of absurd flavors - everything except the most important one: the simple taste of bread. Or an apple. When was the last time we picked one straight from a branch, rubbed it on our clothes, and watched the sunlight glimmer on its skin? Or even spring water. Does anyone even know where the nearest spring is anymore? And yet all we do is move our forks up and down. Fruits and bread exist for us only in logistics lists - shipping and receiving. - Lars

800211c9-1264-4da7-978c-b9b87cd7e86c.name: Diary of a toymaker. Page 4
800211c9-1264-4da7-978c-b9b87cd7e86c.description: I’ve had enough. I don’t want to be part of something that keeps breaking my heart anymore. The Kernel, with its obsessive proselytism, sends its agents to me every day with persistent offers to upgrade to their KERNEL+. Apparently, I’m the last one who hasn’t yet experienced the true greatness of the Second Doctrine… I’ve barricaded myself inside my little room so no one can bother me. Whenever I need something, there are piles of cargo containers nearby. I still go outside through the broken window. They’re so stupid—they can only keep banging on the door... -Lars

3797b64b-3e63-42a2-84c6-8e9f9e743495.name: Diary of a toymaker. Page 5
3797b64b-3e63-42a2-84c6-8e9f9e743495.description: I’m so tired… And still, they got to me. They ambushed me while I was returning to my shelter. They said I would have to listen to them, and to prove how serious they were, they hinted that my supply runs were nothing more than theft - punishable theft. The booth on the catwalk inside the warehouse isn’t the best place, but at least they can’t climb ladders. Then again, the building could collapse at any moment - an entire corner has already fallen away. We’ll see. - Lars

b4ba612f-e4d8-45b0-89f3-bc3bcf4ba6f9.description: Resources have been rather scarce lately, but you're in luck - I found a few leads. Maybe IT -- that item we've been searching for -- is among them.
